{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify and handle sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
# Replace sentinel values with NaN to exclude them from the mean calculation
data_clean = data.copy()
data_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Ensure the column is numeric
print("Data type of biomarker_baseline:", data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].dtype)

# Convert to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
data_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate the mean of biomarker_baseline, excluding sentinel values and NaN
mean_baseline = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_baseline"}
